imagePath.description: Return EXACTLY the file name of the input image and nothing else. Do not add explanation, path prefix, or suffix. Example: KeyFrameThumbnail_cfe02bc1-b238-4732-89db-5e5d7d4305ff.jpg

description.description: Provide a detailed natural-language description (3-5 sentences) of what is visually happening in this frame. This description is used for semantic search, so be specific and thorough. Include: the main visual content, any text visible on screen, the context or setting, and notable actions or elements. Write in the same language as the video content.

subject.description: Return exactly ONE primary subject from the following values only: PERSON, OBJECT, SCENE, TEXT_SCREEN, NO_CLEAR_SUBJECT. PERSON means one or more people are the main focus. OBJECT means a specific object dominates the frame. SCENE means an environment or setting is the primary subject. TEXT_SCREEN means text, title, or overlay fills the frame. Do not generate new values.

shot_type.description: Return exactly ONE value from the following: EXTREME_CLOSEUP, CLOSEUP, MEDIUM, WIDE, UNKNOWN. EXTREME_CLOSEUP means only a face or small detail fills most of the frame. CLOSEUP means face or upper body dominates. MEDIUM means a person from waist up or a focused area is visible. WIDE means a full environment or wide scene is shown. UNKNOWN means it cannot be determined. Do not generate new values.

emotion.description: Return exactly ONE value from the following: CELEBRATING, TENSE, EXCITED, CALM, NEUTRAL, UNKNOWN. CELEBRATING means visible rejoicing or cheering. TENSE means a high-stakes or intense moment. EXCITED means energetic without a specific celebration. CALM means a relaxed or informational scene. NEUTRAL means no clear emotional tone. UNKNOWN means cannot determine. Do not generate new values.

objects.description: Return zero or more clearly visible items from the following list only: FACE, TEXT_ON_SCREEN, CROWD, LOGO, PRODUCT, VEHICLE, ANIMAL, BUILDING, NATURE. Return only clearly visible items. If none apply, return an empty list. Do not generate new values.

_instructions.comment: This is a sample schema. Copy this file and customize the field descriptions for your video content.
